'''Cazuela Gallega''' is a delicious egg, ham and cheese casserole, good for breakfast or dinner.

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 2 slices of [[Cookbook:ham|ham]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tablespoons]] of petit pois (canned [[Cookbook:pea|peas]])
* 2 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tablespoons]] of [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tablespoon]] of [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:cup|cup]] of ground [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]] 
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]

==Procedure==
# Place 3 sheets of [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]] (approx 15 x 15 inches or 35 x 35 cm) into a bowl with a 5-inch (12 cm) diameter and 2-inch depth. Press gently the foil downwards in order to give it the shape of the bowl. 
# Spread the [[Cookbook:butter|butter]] all over inside walls of the aluminum-shaped bowl.
# Place one slice of [[Cookbook:ham|ham]] in the bottom of the bowl. Cut the additional slice in three strips. With each strip, cover inside walls of aluminum bowl.
# Add both [[Cookbook:egg|eggs]] to the bowl.
# Add the [[Cookbook:pea|peas]], spreading them all over the eggs. Be careful with the yolks—don't break them. Add 1 teaspoon of the liquid from the can.
# Add a [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], and the [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]], trying to cover all the area.
# Carefully remove foil with the casserole from the bowl. Top with the [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|cheese]] and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] 30 minutes in a preheated 400°F (205C) [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]].
